script: Mercury, the closest planet to the Sun, has ice. It hides in craters near its poles that never get sunlight. Mercury is barely tilted, so those crater floors stay in permanent shadow. Temperatures there can fall below minus 170 degrees Celsius. NASA's MESSENGER spacecraft confirmed the ice in 2012. Scientists think it may have been delivered by comets and asteroids.
